name: Flush ceiling light
definition: Fitting fixed directly against the ceiling that lights the room from a shade or diffuser close to it.

name: Pendant light
definition: Fitting hung from the ceiling on a cord, chain or rod, with the light source and shade below the ceiling.

name: Chandelier
definition: Branched or tiered hanging fitting that carries several light sources, lit by electricity, gas, oil or candles.

name: Panel light
definition: Flat or shallow ceiling light that sits in a suspended-ceiling grid or on the surface and gives an even spread of light. The troffer is a panel light.

name: Wall light
definition: Fitting fixed to a wall that lights the room, a wall or a passage, whatever its source or fuel.

name: Mirror light
definition: Wall light made to light the face at a mirror. The lit mirror itself is not a lamp.

name: Wall lantern
definition: Fixed fitting in the form of a lantern, bracketed to a wall or post, not made to be carried.

name: Recessed downlight
definition: Fitting sunk into a ceiling so that only its trim shows, casting light downward.

name: Ceiling spotlight
definition: Directional fitting with a swivelling head, fixed to a ceiling or a track head (the bulb of the same name is a spot bulb).

name: Track lighting
definition: Powered rail or cable that carries movable heads along its length, sold as a system.

name: Path light
definition: Low outdoor light standing on the ground to light a path or edge. Solar or mains power is a choice within it.

name: Post light
definition: Tall outdoor fitting on a post or mast that lights a yard, drive or area.

name: Spike light
definition: Outdoor fitting pushed into the soil on a spike, to light a plant, tree or wall from below.

name: Plinth light
definition: Small outdoor or step light set into a surface or low base to light a step, edge or wall.

name: Floodlight
definition: Wide-beam outdoor or area fitting fixed on a wall, post or ground bracket, including the light-only security floodlight and the searchlight.

name: Stage light
definition: Light rigged on a truss, bar or stand to light a stage or event.

name: Table lamp
definition: Lamp with a base and a fixed shade or head that stands on a table. Oil, gas and candle table lamps are table lamps too.

name: Desk lamp
definition: Lamp with an adjustable arm or head made for task light, standing or clamped on. A clip-on desk lamp is a desk lamp.

name: Night light
definition: Small low-output lamp that plugs in or stands to give dim light overnight, including those made for babies.

name: Sunrise lamp
definition: Bedside lamp that brightens gradually to wake the sleeper, with or without a radio.

name: Floor lamp
definition: Tall lamp on a base that stands on the floor beside furniture, with a shade or head near head height.

name: Floor uplighter
definition: Floor-standing lamp whose light is thrown upward to the ceiling.

name: Flashlight
definition: Hand torch from pocket size to duty size, including dive lights. Everyday-carry and tactical torches are flashlights too.

name: Penlight
definition: Slim pen-shaped hand light for close work or inspection.

name: Keychain light
definition: Very small light made to hang from a key ring.

name: Clip-on light
definition: Small light with a clip made to attach to a cap, pocket, strap or bag.

name: Hand searchlight
definition: Large-head or pistol-grip hand spotlight, a different shape from the cylindrical torch.

name: Headlamp
definition: Light worn on the head on a band or cap mount, also called a head torch. Running, ultralight and caving versions are all headlamps.

name: Electric lantern
definition: Carried lantern lit by a battery, rechargeable cell or solar panel.

name: Gas lantern
definition: Carried lantern in which a gas or liquid fuel heats a mantle to give light (propane, liquid fuel, dual fuel).

name: Hurricane lantern
definition: Carried lantern with a wick, a fuel reservoir and a tubular glass globe, burning oil.

name: Candle lantern
definition: Enclosed lantern with a handle that holds a candle, made to be carried.

name: Paper lantern
definition: Collapsible or rigid paper-covered lantern made to be carried as a light. One made to hang as decoration is not a lamp.

name: Clamp work light
definition: Portable work light with a guard and hook, clamped or hung at the job, sold as work or commercial lighting.

name: Trouble light
definition: Portable corded or cordless light on a hook or handle for inspecting dark spaces such as engine bays and crawl spaces.

name: Standard bulb
definition: Pear-shaped bulb for ordinary lamps and fittings. Filament-style and smart bulbs are standard bulbs too.

name: Candle bulb
definition: Slim bulb in the shape of a candle flame, for chandeliers and small fittings.

name: Globe bulb
definition: Round, ball-shaped bulb.

name: Reflector bulb
definition: Bulb with a built-in reflector that throws the light forward (R, BR and PAR shapes).

name: Spot bulb
definition: Small directional bulb for spot fittings, with pin or twist-lock caps (GU10, GU5.3 and MR16 types); the fitting of the same name is a spot fitting.

name: Capsule bulb
definition: Very small bulb with a pin cap, for low-voltage lamps and small fittings (G4 and G9 types).

name: Tube light
definition: Long straight tube light source with its own cap and holder. Fluorescent, LED and halogen tubes are all tube lights.

name: Compact fluorescent bulb
definition: Folded or coiled fluorescent source, of the pin-base types that need their own holder.

name: HID lamp
definition: Discharge source that needs a ballast and cannot be swapped for another source.

name: Strip light
definition: Flexible strip of light sources sold to light a space, such as under a cabinet or in a cove.

name: Lamp shade
definition: Shade made to be fitted to a lamp or fitting.

name: Lamp base
definition: Base or stand sold alone to carry a lamp.

name: Lamp cord set
definition: Cord with a plug and switch or socket made for a lamp. A pendant cord set is a lamp cord set that fits a pendant.

name: Lamp socket
definition: Holder or socket that carries a light source in a lamp or fitting.

name: Chandelier crystal
definition: Crystal drop or glass diffuser made to be fitted to a chandelier or other light.

name: Under-cabinet light
definition: Small puck or slim bar light fixed under or inside a cabinet or shelf to light a worktop or interior. A flexible strip is a strip light.

name: Mobile light tower
definition: Towed or wheeled unit with a raised mast of floodlights, often with its own generator, set up to light a work or event site.

name: High-bay light
definition: Heavy light with a wide reflector or heat-sink body, hung or fixed under a high roof to light a large floor such as a warehouse, workshop or garage.

name: Monitor light bar
definition: Slim bar lamp that clips on top of a computer monitor and throws task light onto the desk without screen glare.
